title: 軌道運輸無障礙月台~Accessible platforms for rail transit
focus: 月台車輛幾何介面與連續無障礙路徑~Platform–vehicle geometry and continuous accessible journeys
summary: 本課聚焦月台車輛幾何介面與連續無障礙路徑。從月台與車體界限建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把無障礙完整旅程與協助登乘時間連成可驗證的介面，最後以使用性測試推論整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies platform–vehicle geometry and continuous accessible journeys. Start with platform and vehicle bounds to define physical or information boundaries, connect complete accessible journey time with assisted boarding time as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through inference from usability trials. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2006 年美國運輸部採用運輸設施無障礙標準。；2022 年城際與高速鐵路月台無障礙指引發布。；2025 年臺灣鐵道車站概念設計指引函頒。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對月台車輛幾何介面與連續無障礙路徑而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用重複量測與共同偏差及使用者能力案例矩陣連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2006: The United States Department of Transportation adopted accessibility standards for transportation facilities. 2022: Guidance for accessible intercity and high-speed platforms was released. 2025: Taiwan issued guidance for conceptual railway-station design. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For platform–vehicle geometry and continuous accessible journeys, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through repeated observations and shared bias and user-capability case matrix. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究月台與車體界限。原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。敏感度只改 body=10 至 11 mm，輸出變為 22 mm；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究重複量測與共同偏差：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate platform and vehicle bounds. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. For sensitivity, change only body=10 to 11 mm; the output becomes 22 mm. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate repeated observations and shared bias: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 月台與車體界限~Platform and vehicle bounds
units.title: 月台與車體界限~Platform and vehicle bounds
units.mechanism: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。保守界限可直接相加，而隨機誤差合成必須有分布與相關性證據；只在空車靜止狀態量一個間隙，無法代表載重與動態情境。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。~Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error. Conservative bounds can be summed, while stochastic combination requires evidence for distributions and correlation. One stationary empty-vehicle measurement cannot represent loaded and dynamic conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance.
units.verify: 建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。以「月台與車體界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources. For platform and vehicle bounds, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。回到「月台與車體界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. Trace the input chain for platform and vehicle bounds. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限~Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
units.practice: 只把車體位移界 body 從 10 改成 11 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 21 變為 22 mm。先說明「月台與車體界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only body displacement bound body from 10 to 11 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 21 to 22 mm. Explain the causal direction for platform and vehicle bounds, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 重複量測與共同偏差~Repeated observations and shared bias
units.title: 重複量測與共同偏差~Repeated observations and shared bias
units.mechanism: 本單元用重複讀值估算分散，再用獨立基準辨認共同偏差，避免重複次數增加帶來虛假的信心。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。~Estimate spread from repeated readings and use an independent reference to identify shared bias, avoiding false confidence from repetition alone. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.
units.verify: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。以「重複量測與共同偏差」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. For repeated observations and shared bias, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。回到「重複量測與共同偏差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for repeated observations and shared bias. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號~Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
units.practice: 只把獨立誤差一標準差 s1 從 3 改成 3.3 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5 變為 5.18556 mm。先說明「重複量測與共同偏差」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only first independent standard deviation s1 from 3 to 3.3 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5 to 5.18556 mm. Explain the causal direction for repeated observations and shared bias, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 坡道縱橫坡分離~Separating ramp slope and cross-slope
units.title: 坡道縱橫坡分離~Separating ramp slope and cross-slope
units.mechanism: 本單元同時保留長向高差與橫向排水需求，將整段平均坡度與輪椅實際輪跡局部坡度比較。坡度以高差除以水平長度定義，不能把斜面長度直接當分母。平均坡度之外還要檢查平台、橫坡與轉折，因為輪椅使用者在坡道終端需要轉向與停止的空間；符合一個幾何比值並不代表整條無障礙路徑連續可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。~Retain longitudinal rise and transverse drainage requirements, comparing whole-route average slope with local slope along actual wheelchair paths. Slope uses rise divided by horizontal run, not sloping surface length. Landings, cross-slope and transitions also matter because wheelchair users need space to turn and stop. Meeting one geometric ratio does not establish continuous usability of an accessible route. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。公式 y=rise/run*100，代入得 y=6 percent。邊界：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m. Formula y=rise/run*100 gives y=6 percent. Boundary: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit.
units.verify: 以同一高程基準量端點，再沿行走路徑抽測局部坡度、橫坡與平台平整度。以「坡道縱橫坡分離」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Survey endpoints on one elevation datum, then sample local slope, cross-slope and landing level along the route. For separating ramp slope and cross-slope, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 兩端平均坡度合格仍可能隱藏短距離陡坡，排水沉陷又可能造成輪椅偏向。回到「坡道縱橫坡分離」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~An acceptable endpoint average can hide a short steep segment, while drainage settlement can introduce a destabilizing cross-slope. Trace the input chain for separating ramp slope and cross-slope. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡~An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
units.practice: 只把水平長度 run 從 7.5 改成 8.25 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變為 5.45455 percent。先說明「坡道縱橫坡分離」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only horizontal run run from 7.5 to 8.25 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 6 to 5.45455 percent. Explain the causal direction for separating ramp slope and cross-slope, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 無障礙完整旅程~Complete accessible journey time
units.title: 無障礙完整旅程~Complete accessible journey time
units.mechanism: 本單元從站外入口追蹤至車廂的連續路徑，將電梯等待、開門與協助時間納入相同系統邊界。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。坡道、門扇與轉乘決策都可能造成停頓；對行動受限旅客而言，較遠但連續可達的路徑往往比短而不連續的路徑更可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。~Trace a continuous journey from the external entrance to the carriage, including lift waits, doors and assistance within one system boundary. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone. Ramps, doors and transfer decisions can introduce pauses. For a mobility-limited traveller, a longer continuously accessible route can be more usable than a shorter route containing an inaccessible interruption. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.
units.verify: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。以「無障礙完整旅程」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. For complete accessible journey time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。回到「無障礙完整旅程」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Trace the input chain for complete accessible journey time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑~The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
units.practice: 只把假想步速 speed 從 0.8 改成 0.88 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 185 變為 171.364 s。先說明「無障礙完整旅程」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only assumed walking speed speed from 0.8 to 0.88 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 185 to 171.364 s. Explain the causal direction for complete accessible journey time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 輔具通行有效空間~Clear space for mobility aids
units.title: 輔具通行有效空間~Clear space for mobility aids
units.mechanism: 本單元把門扇、立柱與轉彎路徑視為幾何限制，明確區分通道流率算例與個人可通行性。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。單位寬流率是情境參數，受方向、坡度與群體能力影響；多條通道的容量只有在下游沒有共同瓶頸時才能直接相加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。~Treat door leaves, columns and turning paths as geometric constraints, distinguishing a passage-flow calculation from individual passability. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance. Specific flow is scenario dependent and varies with direction, slope and user capability. Parallel passage capacities may be added only when they do not share a downstream bottleneck. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.
units.verify: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。以「輔具通行有效空間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. For clear space for mobility aids, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 以建築軸線寬度代替淨寬會高估容量，出口匯流也可能讓上游兩條通道互相阻塞。回到「輔具通行有效空間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Using structural width instead of clear width overstates capacity; merging exits can make two upstream passages obstruct each other. Trace the input chain for clear space for mobility aids. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加~Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
units.practice: 只把有效淨寬 width 從 2.4 改成 2.64 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.64 變為 2.904 persons/s。先說明「輔具通行有效空間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only effective clear width width from 2.4 to 2.64 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.64 to 2.904 persons/s. Explain the causal direction for clear space for mobility aids, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 視覺辨識與暗點~Visual recognition and dark areas
units.title: 視覺辨識與暗點~Visual recognition and dark areas
units.mechanism: 本單元比較月台邊緣、指標與車門前的照度分布，檢查平均值是否掩蓋弱視旅客需要辨認的暗點。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。煙氣、污損與電池老化可能同時降低可見性；指示方向、對比與旅客視力也會影響辨識，不能只用燈具是否亮著作為完成檢核。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。~Compare lighting at platform edges, signs and doors, checking whether an average hides dark areas important to passengers with low vision. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots. Smoke, dirt and battery ageing can reduce visibility together. Directional cues, contrast and eyesight affect recognition, so a lamp being on is not a complete verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。公式 y=flux*util/area，代入得 y=45 lx。邊界：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2. Formula y=flux*util/area gives y=45 lx. Boundary: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values.
units.verify: 以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。以「視覺辨識與暗點」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions. For visual recognition and dark areas, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 亮度集中在燈具下方可能留下暗區，指示牌反光也可降低遠距離的有效對比。回到「視覺辨識與暗點」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Light concentrated beneath fixtures leaves dark regions; sign glare can also reduce effective contrast at a distance. Trace the input chain for visual recognition and dark areas. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口~Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
units.practice: 只把光通量 flux 從 2400 改成 2640 lm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45 變為 49.5 lx。先說明「視覺辨識與暗點」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only luminous flux flux from 2400 to 2640 lm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 45 to 49.5 lx. Explain the causal direction for visual recognition and dark areas, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 協助登乘時間~Assisted boarding time
units.title: 協助登乘時間~Assisted boarding time
units.mechanism: 本單元把一般旅客交換與協助登乘分成可重疊或不可重疊工作，避免用平均停站時間壓縮必要協助。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。~Separate ordinary exchange and assisted boarding into overlapping and non-overlapping tasks, avoiding pressure to compress assistance into an average dwell. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
units.verify: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「協助登乘時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. For assisted boarding time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「協助登乘時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for assisted boarding time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同~Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
units.practice: 只把登車人數 N 從 180 改成 181 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.75 變為 30.8542 s。先說明「協助登乘時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only boarding passengers N from 180 to 181 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 30.75 to 30.8542 s. Explain the causal direction for assisted boarding time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 電梯服務需求累積~Accumulating demand for elevators
units.title: 電梯服務需求累積~Accumulating demand for elevators
units.mechanism: 本單元追蹤行動受限者及攜行李旅客的共同需求，保留無法立即進入下一班電梯的人數。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。~Track shared demand from mobility-limited and luggage-carrying users, retaining those unable to enter the next lift rather than discarding them. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
units.verify: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。以「電梯服務需求累積」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. For accumulating demand for elevators, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「電梯服務需求累積」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for accumulating demand for elevators. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊~Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
units.practice: 只把觀察時間 duration 從 120 改成 132 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 72 變為 79.2 persons。先說明「電梯服務需求累積」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only observation duration duration from 120 to 132 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 72 to 79.2 persons. Explain the causal direction for accumulating demand for elevators, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 使用者能力案例矩陣~User-capability case matrix
units.title: 使用者能力案例矩陣~User-capability case matrix
units.mechanism: 本單元以不同輔具、視覺與聽覺需求檢查同一路徑，要求每個介面都有對應的可觀察任務。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Check one route with different mobility, vision and hearing needs, requiring an observable task for each interface. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「使用者能力案例矩陣」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For user-capability case matrix, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「使用者能力案例矩陣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for user-capability case matrix. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險~One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
units.practice: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「使用者能力案例矩陣」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for user-capability case matrix, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 使用性測試推論~Inference from usability trials
units.title: 使用性測試推論~Inference from usability trials
units.mechanism: 本單元檢查受試者是否涵蓋真正的能力差異，強調有限次順利通行不能證明所有使用者都無障礙。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Check whether participants represent meaningful capability differences; a finite set of successful trips does not establish access for every user. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.verify: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「使用性測試推論」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For inference from usability trials, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「使用性測試推論」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for inference from usability trials. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零~Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
units.practice: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「使用性測試推論」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for inference from usability trials, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

facts: 教學假設：月台與車體界限採 track=8 mm；本課公式結果 21 mm，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for platform and vehicle bounds: track=8 mm; this model gives 21 mm, not a field rating.
教學假設：重複量測與共同偏差採 s1=3 mm；本課公式結果 5 mm，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for repeated observations and shared bias: s1=3 mm; this model gives 5 mm, not a field rating.
教學假設：坡道縱橫坡分離採 rise=0.45 m；本課公式結果 6 percent，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for separating ramp slope and cross-slope: rise=0.45 m; this model gives 6 percent, not a field rating.
教學假設：無障礙完整旅程採 distance=120 m；本課公式結果 185 s，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for complete accessible journey time: distance=120 m; this model gives 185 s, not a field rating.
教學假設：輔具通行有效空間採 width=2.4 m；本課公式結果 2.64 persons/s，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for clear space for mobility aids: width=2.4 m; this model gives 2.64 persons/s, not a field rating.
教學假設：視覺辨識與暗點採 flux=2400 lm；本課公式結果 45 lx，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for visual recognition and dark areas: flux=2400 lm; this model gives 45 lx, not a field rating.
